name: NIFTY 50
about: India's benchmark stock index: the 50 largest companies on the National Stock Exchange (NSE). Prices are in index points, not rupees. The market is open 9:15 to 15:30 IST on weekdays.

name: Gold
about: COMEX gold futures: the international gold price in US dollars per troy ounce (about 31.1 g). Indian MCX gold is quoted in rupees per 10 g and includes import duty, so its numbers look very different.

name: Silver
about: COMEX silver futures, in US dollars per troy ounce. Indian MCX silver is quoted in rupees per kg.

name: Copper
about: COMEX copper futures, in US dollars per pound. Often watched as a signal of global industrial demand.

name: Platinum
about: NYMEX platinum futures, in US dollars per troy ounce. Used in car exhaust systems, jewellery and industry.

name: Palladium
about: NYMEX palladium futures, in US dollars per troy ounce. Mostly used in car exhaust systems.

name: Crude Oil
about: WTI crude oil futures (the US benchmark), in US dollars per barrel.

name: Brent
about: Brent crude oil futures (the international benchmark), in US dollars per barrel.

name: Natural Gas
about: Henry Hub natural gas futures, in US dollars per million BTU. Very volatile and seasonal (heating demand).

name: Wheat
about: CBOT wheat futures, quoted in US cents per bushel.

name: Corn
about: CBOT corn futures, quoted in US cents per bushel.

name: Soybeans
about: CBOT soybean futures, quoted in US cents per bushel.

name: Sugar
about: ICE raw sugar futures, quoted in US cents per pound.

name: Coffee
about: ICE arabica coffee futures, quoted in US cents per pound.

name: Cotton
about: ICE cotton futures, quoted in US cents per pound.
